app.name: MAAR Read
home.intro: MAAR helps you read and learn from the Qur'an, Bible, and Torah in one calm, simple place.
home.disclaimer: MAAR does not create a new religion, does not say one faith is correct, and does not ask you to change what you believe.

onboarding.read.title: Read
onboarding.read.body: Read the Qur'an, Bible, and Torah side by side, in the original language and in translation.
onboarding.search.title: Search
onboarding.search.body: Type any word or topic and find what each scripture actually says about it.
onboarding.compare.title: Compare
onboarding.compare.body: See sources placed next to each other. MAAR never tells you which one is right.
onboarding.notes.title: Take notes
onboarding.notes.body: Save verses and write private notes that stay only on your device.
about.title: About MAAR
about.body: MAAR helps people read and learn about the Qur'an, Bible, and Torah in one place. We show the sources clearly and help people compare topics. MAAR does not create a new religion and does not ask anyone to change their faith. Our goal is simple: honest learning, clear information, and respectful understanding.
